In return, I'd have $115 plus my current $80 to invest in my orange properties, checking whether that's enough to add another house on St James, Tennessee, or NY.

Getting to three houses on my orange set is huge given the rent jump, and even though p4 could eventually threaten with yellow, their cash is thin so I'm leaning toward accepting the deal despite being cash-poor myself.
